title: Chapter 1: Introduction to NVIDIA Isaac Sim
description: NVIDIA Isaac Sim is a powerful, scalable robotics simulation platform built on NVIDIA Omniverse. It accelerates the development, testing, and deployment of AI-enabled robots by providing a highly realistic and physically accurate virtual environment. Isaac Sim is designed for a wide range of robotics applications, from manufacturing and logistics to healthcare and autonomous vehicles.
